# A Major

A Major is a software company for the agent era, based in Singapore. We build Ryu.

## Ryu

> A managed platform for AI agents.

Ryu is a managed platform for AI agents, built on open-source infrastructure. Start without building from scratch, add tools with plugins, and turn your agents into apps. Monitor every run and control what your agents can access.

- [Ryu](https://amajor.ai/products/ryu): Product overview
- [ryuhq.com](https://ryuhq.com): Ryu homepage (Research Preview)

## Products

> Most AI agents didn't deliver. We build the ones that do.

- [Products](https://amajor.ai/products): All A Major products, including Ryu and Backstage
- [Backstage](https://amajor.ai/products/backstage): The open-source YouTube thumbnail studio
